summary: J-Star Holding, a Cayman Islands Nasdaq-listed issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an Equity Purchase Agreement dated September 24, 2026 with Hudson Global Ventures, LLC, a Nevada LLC. The company has the right, not the obligation, to sell up to $35,000,000 of Class A ordinary shares over a 36-month commitment period, in put notices of at least $25,000 and up to the lesser of $2,500,000 or 200% of average daily trading value, priced at 95% of the average of the three lowest traded prices in the prior five sessions. 525,000 warrants were issued for the commitment, with resale registration rights. Watch dilution pace and warrant overhang.
